title: Hopwise decision reasoning with causal-tags for fallback attribution
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Current routing observability captures which model or region was selected for a request but often lacks a causal trail that explains *why* a fallback model or non-preferred region was chosen. This impedes debugging when requests hit fallbacks that degrade latency or quality.

Goal: Produce per-hop, human- and machine-readable reasoning breadcrumbs (causal-tags) attached to routing decision events so we can: 1) explain fallback choices, 2) correlate SLO regressions to specific decision predicates, and 3) build rollup metrics that attribute latency/cost/quality changes to decision logic rather than downstream infra alone.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Routing decision event emitted for each hop contains a compact causal-tag list (predicate ids, evaluated values, priority score, and policy-version).
2) Fallback events include a top-2 contributing predicates and an estimated SLO impact delta field (ms and cost cents).
3) End-to-end trace can reconstruct hop order and join causal-tags to per-hop micrometrics (p50/p95 token latency, token count).
4) New aggregated dashboards show attribution by predicate and policy-version and can be filtered by customer tier/region/model-variant.
5) Instrumentation must add <5% p99 overhead on routing path in our staging traffic profile.
design_decisions: Emit causal-tags as a compressed comma-separated token in the routing envelope to avoid schema churn in telemetry pipelines.
Represent predicates by stable short ids (4-8 chars) with a lookup table stored in config-service and versioned per policy rollout.
Attach an estimated SLO delta computed by the router heuristics (heuristic model trained offline) rather than attempting exact downstream simulation in-path.
Sampling: full causal-tags for 0.5% of requests, header-only indicators for 10% of requests, and aggregated counters for all requests to control cost.

Fallback attribution captures both decision-layer causes and immediate resource-availability signals (e.g., capacity-tier-fill, region-constraint) to separate policy-based and capacity-based fallbacks.
tasks: Spec: define causal-tag schema and stable predicate-id registry (RFC)
Runtime: add causal-tag enrichment hook in routing decision engine (C++ runtime + Go router shim)
Telemetry: add parser to ingestion pipeline to expand compressed causal-tags into structured rows in BigQuery/ClickHouse
Dashboard: build two new Grafana panels: 'Predicate Attribution' and 'Fallback SLO Delta by Policy'
E2E test: create synthetic scenarios that force policy- and capacity-based fallbacks and validate attribution accuracy
Perf test: run staging traffic with sampling to validate <5% p99 overhead and document results
